name: Rylen Kenna
source:
Rylen cannot be more than thirty years old, and no one would be quick to calling him wise or mature, but he has a certain knowledge behind his eyes, grown from either grand or terrible experiences. He has an older brother, Tiernan. Any other family he rarely speaks of.

When exactly Rylen turned to piracy is something of a blur, even to the man himself, who seems to think he has always been among the crew of The Serpentine. He expresses no desire to change nor seems to regret a thing, yet, for as amoral as this surely makes him, he is relatively pleasant to be around. He is quick to smiling, even cryptic as that smile sometimes is, and is trusted and befriended by most of his crew.(from official website)
